comment: MAKER BUG: the normalling test at ManMute8.cpp:224 reads inputs[CV1_INPUT] instead of inputs[CV1_INPUT + i], so the carried-over voltage array is refreshed only while section 1's IN jack is patched. With section 1 empty, every unmuted output stays at 0V no matter what is patched into sections 2 to 8. The maker's manual says each CV input is normalized to the previous one, and the panel draws the arrowheads for it.
